name: Ballpoint Pen Drawing
visualIdentity: Thin blue-black or black lines, repeated contours, and dense-to-sparse hatching on clean white or lightly warm paper. Keep a sketchbook character; reveal marks in drawing order or as layered sketches. The palette is a style-compatible suggestion, not canonical: #FCFAF4 paper and #172C49 ink.
suitableUses: Explicitly suited to sketchbook storytelling. Source-listed combinations suggest travel journals, field notes, idea-to-product stories, explanatory and illustrated narratives, and long narration holds. Suitability for interactive HTML is inferred from the suggested notebook-page interaction.
limitations: Avoid heavy outlines, smooth vector fills, extra ink colors, and fast or random line boil. Chapter transitions suit coherent narratives but should be omitted when boundaries obscure causality, violate a continuous shot or loop, or add no value. Supplied palettes and artwork take precedence.
palette: Suggested monochrome roles: opaque background #FCFAF4 and foreground #172C49; keep tone in hatching, patterns, or opacity, not added hues. Preserve task, brand, reference, and asset colors. Gradients are disabled. The sample text pair has 13.477 contrast, but all actual compositions require checking.
motionAndInteraction: Store contours and hatching as SVG paths, composite fine pen texture in Canvas, and reveal paths in plausible drawing order. Motion can use a deterministic, seekable GSAP timeline; optional Motion needs verified seek synchronization. For HTML, notes may appear on focus or tap; reduce-motion and pause controls are specified for looping variants. Scroll-driven chapters or story states are optional only when they serve the narrative; reverse progress must restore matching states.
audio: No fixed soundtrack is specified. Choose music, voiceover, vocals, effects, ambience, or silence for the subject and audience; honor supplied audio choices. Audio should support scene pacing and leave room for speech and comprehension. Check intelligibility, balance, clipping, and picture synchronization.
assetRequirements: Use approved source artwork and exact copy where supplied. Prepare contours and hatching as SVG paths, with fine pen texture composited in Canvas. Keep assets local and deterministic; seed and cache generated geometry. Rough.js is optional for sketch contours, hachure, or doodles, but does not supply handwriting, authentic pen media, or authored drawing order. Missing assets are unspecified.
combinations: Pairs naturally with style-024 for same-pen arrows and handwritten labels, drawn after the referenced sketch, and style-092 for a slow, fixed-cadence swap between pen variants on completed sketches only. Preserve one ink and thin strokes; no boil during drawing or on lettering. Chapter-transition and storytelling patterns are optional, not required.
productionApproach: Choose the visual renderer and motion method for style fidelity first. SVG, Canvas 2D, and GSAP are recommended; Rough.js and Motion are optional. HyperFrames owns composition, timing, media/audio sync, validation, and export; use Remotion only if unavailable or a verified limitation blocks a required capability, recording why. For video, derive state from seekable composition time; for HTML, scroll may drive narrative progress. Check representative frames, transitions, accessibility behavior, and final playback.
